description: This Java class 'CreateUserCommandHandler' handles user creation commands in the Fineract project framework. It is responsible for processing commands to create new user accounts by delegating to the 'AppUserWritePlatformService'.

classes.name: CreateUserCommandHandler
classes.description: A Spring Service that handles user creation commands within the Fineract framework, implementing the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: CreateUserCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that injects the AppUserWritePlatformService dependency.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes the creation command by delegating to the write platform service to create a new user.
